categories.main_business_segments: Tianjin MOTIMO Membrane Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of hollow fiber membrane materials and membrane components, as well as membrane separation and water treatment equipment. The company provides integrated water resource solutions and industrial special separation solutions, including design, engineering, equipment manufacturing, installation, and operation services. Key products include hollow fiber column and curtain membrane components, continuous membrane filtration (CMF) equipment, submerged membrane filtration (SMF) equipment, membrane bioreactors (MBR), integrated membrane sewage treatment equipment, industrial special separation membrane equipment, and HPS high-efficiency clarifiers. The company also operates in water treatment engineering, sewage treatment, and design services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in hollow fiber membrane technology with a history dating back to 1974, leveraging wet spinning, blending, and modification techniques to produce PVDF and other polymer membranes. It has developed advanced membrane materials such as modified PVDF membranes, composite membranes, and special separation membranes. The company also innovates in membrane bioreactor systems with new pulse aeration technology and pressure-type hollow fiber membrane filtration integration. Production methods emphasize high-density membrane packing, high flux, low energy consumption, and modular construction. The company holds multiple national and provincial technology awards and patents, reflecting strong R&D capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves municipal water supply and sewage treatment sectors, industrial water treatment including steel, power, petrochemical, coal chemical, textile, semiconductor, and biopharmaceutical industries. Customers include municipal units, industrial enterprises, water companies, and design institutes. The company also targets emerging markets such as seawater desalination, unconventional water resource utilization, and coal mine gas comprehensive utilization. Its products and solutions are applied in water purification, wastewater treatment and reuse, industrial material separation, concentration, and purification.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales concentrated domestically (over 98% of revenue). It has projects and customers across multiple provinces including Gansu, Shaanxi, Qinghai, Ningxia, Xinjiang, Shandong, and Tianjin. The company also has minor overseas sales (about 2% of revenue). Its subsidiaries and joint ventures are located in various Chinese regions, supporting regional market penetration and project execution.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianjin MOTIMO operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the membrane industry supply chain. It manufactures core membrane materials and components (midstream) and integrates these into membrane equipment and systems for water treatment and industrial separation applications (downstream). The company also provides engineering design, system integration, and operational services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in the membrane technology and water treatment value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in hollow fiber membrane materials, including low-cost, high-flux PVDF membranes for seawater desalination and wastewater treatment. It focuses on developing anti-fouling membranes, nanofiltration membranes, and membranes for semiconductor ultra-pure water. R&D efforts also target membrane bioreactor technology improvements and intelligent membrane equipment manufacturing. The company leverages national key laboratories and industry collaborations to enhance technology leadership and expand applications in water resource recovery, industrial separation, and emerging fields like coal mine gas utilization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of membrane components and water treatment equipment, system integration contracts, and water treatment operation and technical service fees. The company sells products directly to industry intermediaries and end users, provides engineering design and construction services, and operates water treatment projects under concession or service contracts. Other income includes investment returns and government subsidies, with minor revenue from leasing and technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the earliest and leading domestic producers of hollow fiber membrane components in China, holding a strong position in the ultrafiltration and microfiltration membrane market. It competes with international membrane brands from the US, Japan, and other countries, especially in high-performance membrane materials and industrial applications. While it has achieved significant domestic market penetration and import substitution in municipal and industrial water treatment membranes, competition remains intense, particularly from foreign suppliers in nanofiltration and reverse osmosis membranes. The company also faces competition from other membrane types such as spiral-wound and flat-sheet membranes.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 246 million, a 22% increase over the previous year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 11 million, reversing prior losses. The company’s total assets were around RMB 948 million with equity of RMB 577 million. Despite improvements, the company’s profitability remains modest, and it continues to face challenges such as credit risks and competitive pricing pressures. The company’s R&D investment remains robust at over 10% of revenue, supporting sustained innovation and growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its long-standing expertise and technological leadership in hollow fiber membrane technology, offering high-performance, cost-effective membrane products with superior flux, fouling resistance, and modular design. Its integrated solutions cover the full water treatment value chain from materials to system operation, providing customers with reliable, efficient, and scalable water purification and industrial separation technologies. The proprietary HPS high-efficiency clarifier technology offers operational simplicity, low energy consumption, and high treatment capacity, differentiating the company in high-turbidity water treatment markets. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and national-level certifications underpin its competitive advantage.
